digest.component_or_area: Development process governance and audit follow-up
propositions: Six process improvement recommendations from the bleakish-stational-cob audit must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor work, design decisions, and implementation tickets before becoming new work items, with documented rationale for any reversal.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as optional present-only capture in evadible-ambitious-canary with 1.1% coverage; the refine disposition preserves fail-open creation and expands automatic stamping at known filer boundaries rather than adding mandatory fields.

Deterministic plan preflight exists at P1-P11 (not P1-P8); extension should require offline replay against historical pass/block cohorts, explicit false-positive ceilings, and fail-open behavior before promotion, avoiding a second generic framework.

Completion-failure classification requires offline analysis of 351 existing failure sidecars to validate stable categories (code defect, unmet AC, missing evidence, plan gap, environment failure, verifier failure) before adding schema; do not treat all non-PASS as escaped defects.

Risk-tiered review should pilot without merge enforcement, evaluating prospective signals (security/store/concurrency surfaces, diff breadth, complexity, plan failures) and measuring defect/revert rates by tier before choosing thresholds; human review requirement is inapplicable because this project uses autonomous agentic Gerrit.

Proactive debt management: the 720-LOC soft warning already shipped in Gerrit change 1751; do not adopt arbitrary duplication quotas as standalone objectives; prioritize debt only at complexity/churn/defect/architectural-centrality intersections.
